useCase.name: Run the reports against the published timetable, including the free-period list substitution cover is chosen from

intent.name: report.timetable.run
intent.summary: Run a timetable report — a section's timetable, a teacher's, workload in periods per week, free periods by slot, substitutions by teacher — for the section, teacher, day or week the reader sets. Only the published timetable.

steps.note: One read, against the published timetable only (BR-3). The run is recorded (BR-8).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. No published timetable, no permission, or no day or week runs nothing. A slot with nobody free is an empty list, not a failure.
plan.atomicity: A read. It changes nothing (BR-7); the only write is the record of the run (BR-8).

operations.name: report.timetable.run
operations.purpose: Run a timetable report from the catalogue.

parameters.name: report_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No timetable report this reader may run matches — the catalogue offers only what the role permits.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the matching reports from the catalogue.

parameters.notes: The report, from the catalogue's timetable group: Class and section timetable; Teacher timetable; Teacher workload in periods per week; Free periods by slot; Substitutions assigned by teacher. Only the reports the reader's role permits are offered.

parameters.name: section_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No section this reader may see matches.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the matching sections with their class.

parameters.notes: The section, where the report covers one. A teacher is offered only the sections they teach (BR-6, E3).

parameters.name: teacher_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No teacher at this branch matches.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the matching teachers with their subjects.

parameters.notes: The teacher, where the report covers one.

parameters.name: subject_id
parameters.notes: For free periods: the subject cover is needed for (E4).

parameters.name: day_or_week
parameters.notes: The day or week the report covers (BR-2, E6).

parameters.name: slot
parameters.notes: For free periods: the period within that day (BR-4).

parameters.name: staff_id
parameters.notes: The reader. Every run is recorded against them. Never from the request.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: result_id
fields.description: The run. It is taken away with report.export — UC-24-19.

fields.name: parameters
fields.description: The period and scope it ran with, as printed on any output.

fields.name: paged
fields.description: True where the result is paged rather than shown whole.

fields.name: free_teachers
fields.description: On free periods: teachers not teaching, not already covering, and not on approved leave in the slot (BR-4).

fields.name: cover_by_teacher
fields.description: On substitutions: cover grouped by teacher (BR-5).

fields.name: no_lecture_days
fields.description: Days closed by the calendar, and meeting days for a participating class — no lectures show (BR-10).

errors.meaning: No timetable is published for the section.
The reader does not hold the permission for this report.
A teacher asked for a section they do not teach.
No teacher of the subject is free in the slot.
errors.note: The list is empty and says so, rather than suggesting somebody unsuitable (BR-4).

errors.meaning: No day or week was set.

operations.writesOnRead: The run is recorded — who ran it, which report and over what scope (BR-8).

planningRules.rule: Only the published timetable. A draft appears in no report, since nothing in it has been agreed (BR-3, A4, AC-1).

Never suggest a teacher who is not on the free list. Free means not teaching, not already covering and not on approved leave — a list missing any of the three sends a teacher to a class they cannot take (BR-4, A1, A2, AC-2, AC-3, AC-4).
Where nobody is free, say so. An empty list is the answer, not a reason to offer the nearest teacher (E4, AC-5).
Say that marked unavailability is not accounted for. Nothing records it, so only teaching, cover and approved leave are excluded (OQ-2).
Show substitutions grouped by teacher, so cover falling repeatedly on the same people is visible (BR-5, A3, AC-6).
Show no lectures on a day the calendar closes, or on a meeting day for a participating class — none runs (BR-10, A5, AC-8).
On workload, give the figures and flag nobody. There is no maximum load to measure against (OQ-1).
A teacher gets their own timetable and the sections they teach (BR-6, E3, AC-7).
Never change a timetable from a report. It is changed through its own approval route (BR-7, E5, AC-9).
Say that the run is recorded, and take the report away only through report.export — UC-24-19. There is no route out of its own (BR-8, BR-9).
staff_id and branch_id come from $session. A figure across branches is report.combined.run — the Super Admin's alone.

reversal.statement: A report changes nothing a plan can take back. The record of the run stands (BR-8).

operations.name: timetable.mine.read
operations.purpose: Return a teacher's own timetable, or the section timetable of a student or a guardian's child.

parameters.name: student_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. None of this guardian's children matches.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the guardian's children with their class.

parameters.notes: For a guardian: which child's section. Omitted for a teacher, who reads their own, and for a student, who reads their own section (BR-6, A6).

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: timetable
fields.description: Day, period, subject, teacher and room, from the published timetable (BR-3).

fields.name: no_lecture_days
fields.description: Closed days and meeting days, on which nothing runs (BR-10).

errors.meaning: No timetable is published for the section.

operations.writesOnRead: The reading is recorded, as every report run is (BR-8, AC-10).

planningRules.rule: A teacher reads their own timetable; a student and a guardian read the section's (BR-6, A6).
Show no lectures on a closed day, or on a meeting day for a participating class (BR-10, AC-8).

reversal.statement: A read changes nothing a plan can take back. The record of the reading stands (BR-8).
